title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Ecosystem Expansion: OpenAI is blurring the lines of development by releasing 'Sites' directly into Codex for end-to-end deployment, while extending access to their frontier models via AWS Bedrock.
Tooling Upgrades: Anthropic continues to refine its ecosystem by launching a dedicated CLI for the Claude Platform and expanding Project Glasswing's footprint globally.

Open Source Momentum: The open-source AI community pushes forward with the release of Holo 3.1, a fast and efficient local computer-use model optimized specifically for GUI understanding and navigation.

Market Realities: Serious capital and concerns intersect as Warren Buffett reportedly invests $10 billion into AI infrastructure, simultaneously as reports emerge detailing Silicon Valley's internal anxieties about AI displacing knowledge workers.

Real-World AI Utility: Developers are sharing advanced productivity frameworks, from utilizing AI to stitch together deleted SQLite overflow pages to recover lost work, to structuring robust autonomous execution loops with AI goal commands.

items.title: @AnthropicAI: Anthropic Expands Project Glasswing
items.body: Anthropic is extending access to the Claude Mythos Preview to over 150 additional organizations across more than 15 countries. This signals a broadening of their specialized or experimental model deployments to a wider array of enterprise partners.

items.title: @theo: OpenAI Models Arrive on AWS Bedrock
items.body: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS Bedrock, offering enterprise customers a secure and compliant path to integrate OpenAI technologies. The rollout will also pave the way for future cybersecurity capabilities like Daybreak.

items.title: @ClaudeDevs: Official CLI for Claude Platform
items.body: Anthropic has released a dedicated command-line interface for the Claude Platform, allowing developers to call the Messages API, run Claude Managed Agents, and pipe results directly in the terminal. The tool is highly optimized to be utilized by AI coding agents.

items.title: @TheRohanVarma: OpenAI Launches 'Sites' in Codex
items.body: OpenAI has introduced 'Sites' into Codex, allowing users to build, deploy, and host full-stack applications directly from the chat interface. The feature natively supports authentication and dynamic databases, empowering non-technical users to deploy software end-to-end.

items.title: @TeksEdge: Holo 3.1 Local Computer-Use LLM
items.body: French AI startup H Company has launched Holo 3.1, an open-source model specialized in GUI understanding and computer control that runs entirely locally. Built on the Qwen architecture, it reportedly outperforms similar models in local desktop automation tasks.

items.title: @Alpha_Cat: Warren Buffett Backs AI Infrastructure
items.body: Warren Buffett has reportedly committed a massive $10 billion investment towards AI infrastructure development. This substantial capital allocation from a traditionally conservative investor suggests long-term market confidence in AI's foundational physical layer.

items.title: @pete80155006: Silicon Valley's Private AI Anxieties
items.body: A New York Times report allegedly exposes deep-seated anxieties among Silicon Valley elites regarding AI's impact on employment and societal stability. The internal consensus reportedly points to a rapid hollowing-out of knowledge-worker roles and severe class stratification.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Denzel Dumfries to Real Madrid
items.body: Real Madrid has successfully agreed to terms with Inter Milan's Dutch right-back Denzel Dumfries. The Spanish club will trigger his €20m release clause, marking a significant strategic reinforcement of their defensive lineup.

items.title: @EwanMacKenna: FIFA Cancels US Hotel Block Bookings
items.body: FIFA has abruptly cancelled its widespread block bookings of hotel rooms across the US, a move initially made to artificially inflate demand ahead of the 2026 World Cup. The reversal highlights ongoing logistical and pricing controversies surrounding the upcoming tournament.

items.title: @giansegato: Claude Recovers Lost Work via SQLite
items.body: A user successfully utilized Claude to recover a lost 11-hour report by having the AI reverse-engineer the Alfred clipboard manager's SQLite database. Claude scanned the raw database, bypassed deletion markers, and stitched the document back together from overflow pages.

items.title: @0xTodd: Epic Rescue from Internet Addiction Camp
items.body: A viral story details a man's methodical and successful cross-country journey to rescue his girlfriend from a coercive internet addiction school in China. The account highlights the extreme lengths of parental control and the striking real-life application of strategy to secure her freedom.

items.title: @dotey: Advanced Strategies for AI /goal Workflows
items.body: A developer shares practical frameworks for leveraging the /goal command in AI coding tools, such as breaking complex tasks into phased checklists. By setting strict acceptance criteria for each phase, users can maintain high-quality, sequential autonomous execution.

items.title: @elonmusk: Debate Over Justice in Henry Nowak Case
items.body: Elon Musk amplified ongoing public debate surrounding the tragic murder of Henry Nowak, drawing comparisons to international social justice movements. The discourse highlights perceived media disparities and demands for accountability in the British justice system.
